einzeiler: A reading from Ricky Offord's near-death experience book, 33 Days Between Heaven and Hell.
kurzfassung: The host reads an excerpt from Ricky Offord's book detailing his near-death experience during a medically induced coma. The narrative covers his arrival in a peaceful spiritual home, a high-speed journey through the cosmos, and standing in a queue for judgment. Ultimately, Offord pleads to return to Earth, believing his life purpose is unfinished before vanishing from the line.
stichpunkte: Reading from chapter 14 of Ricky Offord's book '33 Days Between Heaven and Hell'
The author describes entering a medically induced coma and experiencing the awakening of his eternal spirit
Finding himself in a cozy, welcoming house filled with familiar, joyful people
Realizing he no longer felt sick and still possessed all five physical senses
Ascending through the ceiling with companions to travel rapidly across the universe
Witnessing breathtaking extraterrestrial beauty and an array of unknown colors
Finding himself standing in an orderly line of people that he recognized as the place of judgment
Overwhelmed by emotion, he wept and prayed to God for more time to fulfill his earthly purpose
Pleading with the Lord, he vanished from the line in an instant after promising to dedicate his life to Him

clips.hook: Forgetting recent struggles and feeling completely healthy again
clips.text: The author notes a sudden contrast between his recent physical agony and his current state of complete wellness.

clips.hook: Moving at light speed through unknown dimensions
clips.text: The group accelerates to immense speeds, crossing through various realms and dimensions beyond human understanding.

clips.hook: Experiencing profound safety reminiscent of childhood
clips.text: Despite the intimidating surroundings, an overwhelming sense of warmth and complete security washes over him.

beschreibung:
This episode I am reading from Rickey Offord's book '33 Days Between Heaven and Hell: A True Miracle Story – One Man’s Near-Death Experience and Visit to the Afterlife'

When a routine surgery plunged him into a coma, successful music producer Rickey “Slikk Muzik” Offord began the fight of his life. Given up for dead three times, his body lay unresponsive, but his spirit remained wide awake as he was thrown into a harrowing, thirty-three-day odyssey through the spiritual world.

In 33 Days Between Heaven and Hell, Rickey shares his unforgettable journey, taking you to the glowing realm of heaven and into the darkest alleys of hell. You’ll also stand alongside his mother and sister, seeing through their eyes the medical miracle that kept him tethered to this world. Meet the angels and demons he encountered and bear witness to the supernatural war that rages just beyond our senses.

Rickey's story is the riveting testimony of a man who returned from the edge of eternity with a powerful message of hope. It will challenge everything you think you know about life and death and leave you with one undeniable truth: miracles still happen.

Bio

Dallas native Rickey “Slikk Muzik” Offord is a four-time Grammy Award–winning producer and composer. His journey from corporate America to the music industry is one of unwavering determination. After taking a leap of faith, he endured hardship—including a period of homelessness—to pursue his dreams in Hollywood. His resilience was tested further in 2016 when a routine surgery led to three cardiac arrests and a thirty-three-day coma. Emerging from this life-altering experience, Slikk’s faith and passion for music only deepened, inspiring him to create timeless works that transcend Slikk has received Grammy Awards for his groundbreaking work, including Tori Kelly’s Hiding Place (Best Gospel Album) and Never Alone (Best Gospel Performance/Song), as well as Lecrae’s Church Clothes 4 (Best Contemporary Christian Music Album) and DOE’s Heart of a Human (Best Contemporary Christian Album). Beyond these wins, his work has earned seven additional Grammy nominations, including recognition for Ariana Grande’s Yours Truly, GloRilla’s Glorious, and Sheila E.’s Bailar. With over a billion career streams to his credit, an Oscar nomination and Golden Globe for his work on the hit series Atlanta, and twelve Billboard #1 records, Slikk’s mission remains clear: to create music that resonates across generations, cultures, and industries.
